scientific_question: Can annotation-independent large-universe raw-DNA search recover a longer, formal-RVT-supported homolog of the frozen 30 novelty-first rescue queries, and subsequently discover de novo RT-like systems without depending on the original ACNV+recurrence candidate universe?

stage_plan.F3A0: query-blind external source selection and DNA-universe freeze
stage_plan.F3A1: frozen 30-query protein-to-nucleotide translated expansion plus frozen RVT-All confirmation
stage_plan.F3B: de novo annotation-independent six-frame RVT discovery on the exact F3A0 frozen external universe; executable instantiated only after the F3A0 universe hash is frozen
stage_plan.F3C: orthogonal novelty, motif-topology, family replication and calibrated structure closure for F3B leads

source_diversity_gate: at least 5 strata each contributing >=100 Mb and at least 24 accepted SRA accessions
translation: protein-to-nucleotide translated search; maximal stop-to-stop ORF recovery; code 11; no start-codon requirement; minimum recovered ORF 45 aa
core_homolog_rule: non-exact recovered ORF AND search evalue <= 1e-5 AND qcov >= 0.70 AND fident >= 0.25
broad_homolog_rule: non-exact recovered ORF AND search evalue <= 1e-3 AND qcov >= 0.50
major_extension_rule: longer target AND recovered_ORF_length >= max(180, 1.5 * query_length)
formal_rvt_rule: full E <= 1e-4 AND best domain i-E <= 1e-4 using the frozen ~45-profile RVT-All collection
exploratory_rvt_rule: full E <= 1e-2 AND best domain i-E <= 1e-2; descriptive only
primary_endpoint: number of frozen F2E query-components with >=1 external non-exact longer recovered ORF satisfying the frozen formal RVT-All rule
secondary_endpoints: formal longer homologs replicated across >=2 external SRA accessions
best formal longer homolog model coverage / query coverage / YxDD-like status
claim_boundary: F3A is an external family-expansion experiment. Homology plus formal RVT-HMM support is not biochemical RT proof. F3B/F3C remain required for de novo discovery and orthogonal validation. Negative F3A does not exclude more divergent, recoded, frameshifted, or non-profile-detectable RT systems.
